content: The EO Premium 601 Series is a brand of hand-crafted premium cigars owned by EO Brands/United Tobacco. History and Background The brand was created by José Pepin Garcia and is manufactured at the Tabacalera Cubana factory located in Estelí, Nicaragua. It was first introduced to the market in August 2006. Honors, Awards, and Ratings The 601 Connecticut Robusto received a rating of 88 in the February 2007 issue of Cigar Aficionado magazine. The 601 Habano (Red Label) Robusto was awarded a rating of 90 in the October 2007 issue of Cigar Aficionado magazine. It was described as having good oils and deep color, making it a beautiful cigar. Rich coffee bean and licorice notes are balanced by a wheaty finish. A medium to full-bodied smoke. In the October issue of Cigar Snob magazine, the 601 Habano was praised for delivering bold, rich flavors of dark coffee, mocha, and spice, while maintaining a well-balanced profile for a full-bodied cigar. Description The EO Premium 601 Series is available in four ranges, each consisting of five vitolas, and one additional range with four vitolas. All ranges are packaged in boxes containing 20 cigars. 601 Connecticut This is a medium to full-bodied cigar. The filler and binder are made from Nicaraguan tobacco, while the wrapper is Ecuadorian-grown Connecticut-seed tobacco. The band features gold printing on a black background. 601 Habano This is a full-bodied cigar. The filler and binder are composed of Nicaraguan tobaccos, and the wrapper is Nicaraguan Habano. The band is designed with gold printing on a red background. It is worth noting that this line is often mistakenly referred to as maduro by some dealers. 601 Box-Pressed Maduro Released in late March 2007, this was the first box-pressed cigar and the first maduro cigar ever produced by Pepin Garcia. It is a full-bodied cigar, with the filler and binder made from aged Nicaraguan tobaccos, and the wrapper is Nicaraguan Maduro. The band features gold printing on a blue background.
